'''Star Tours Flight 1119''' was the designation of two [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] owned flights at various times. The first was the designation of a Star Tours-owned flight to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] at the time of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]]. It was stationed at Gate 1A, had arrived on time at 0635 hours and was boarding passengers in preparation for it's next departure at 0730.<ref name="ST2">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref> The second was the designation of a non-stop flight to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] offered to passengers by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency around [[4 ABY/Legends|4.3 ABY]].<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>
